import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-15')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}
vix=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut]
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])|set(vix.index)); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); v=vix.reindex(idx).ffill()
# Stress-conditioned short-term reversal: recent 5d loss is expected to rebound, with larger signal in elevated VIX.
r5=p/p.shift(5)-1
vz=(v-v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).mean())/(v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).std()+1e-8)
stress=(1+vz.clip(lower=0,upper=2)).where(vz.notna())
f=(-r5*stress).shift(1)
# winsorize cross-section to prevent crypto outliers dominating
lo=f.quantile(.05,axis=1); hi=f.quantile(.95,axis=1); f=f.clip(lo,hi,axis=0)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date(),'macro_valid',v.notna().sum())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[]; Ns=[]; ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   z=spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic
   if np.isfinite(z): I.append(z);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==10: print('annual10',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); turn=(rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna(); print('turnover',round(turn.mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-15')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}; vx=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut]
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])|set(vx.index)); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); v=vx.reindex(idx).ffill()
r5=p/p.shift(5)-1; vz=(v-v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).mean())/(v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).std()+1e-8); stress=(1+vz.clip(lower=0,upper=2)).to_numpy()[:,None]; f=(-r5.to_numpy()*stress); f=pd.DataFrame(f,index=p.index,columns=p.columns).shift(1); f=f.clip(f.quantile(.05,axis=1),f.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1: I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==10: print('annual10',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-15')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}
vx=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut]
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])|set(vx.index)); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); v=vx.reindex(idx).ffill()
r=p.pct_change(); vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); vz=(v-v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).mean())/(v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).std()+1e-8)
# Low realized volatility, increasingly emphasized during elevated VIX; lag signal one day.
f=(-vol*(1+vz.clip(lower=0,upper=2)).to_numpy()[:,None]); f=pd.DataFrame(f,index=p.index,columns=p.columns).shift(1)
f=f.clip(f.quantile(.05,axis=1),f.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'instruments',U,'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1: I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==10: print('annual10',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
# regime split

from scipy.stats import spearmanr

f=(-vol*(1+vz.clip(lower=0,upper=2)).to_numpy()[:,None]); f=pd.DataFrame(f,index=p.index,columns=p.columns).shift(1)
f=f.clip(f.quantile(.05,axis=1),f.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'instruments',U,'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1: I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(p.index[i])

 if h==10: print('annual10',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

## Explored Factors

1. **VIX-Stress-Weighted Low-Volatility**
   - Construction: negative 20-day realized volatility, scaled upward when lagged VIX was above its rolling 120-day mean:
     \[
     f_t=-\sigma_{20,t}\left(1+\operatorname{clip}(z_{\mathrm{VIX},t},0,2)\right)
     \]
   - The signal was lagged by one session, cross-sectionally winsorized at the 5th/95th percentiles, and evaluated across all 15 tradable instruments.
   - Research script: `scripts/miner_3_20261231_stress_weighted_lowvol.py`
   - Validation cutoff: **2026-07-15**
   - Universe: **15 instruments**

## Validation Results

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 2,322 | 15.0 | 100.00% | -0.025428 | -0.069618 | 47.16% |

| 20d | 2,307 | 15.0 | 100.00% | -0.038762 | -0.111608 | 45.12% |

Annual 10-day IC:

- 2020: -0.096909
- 2021: -0.084843
- 2022: -0.004393
- 2023: -0.046840
- 2024: -0.014760
- 2025: +0.027632
- 2026: -0.066897

Additional diagnostics:

- Average rank turnover: **0.023976**
- Dates with at least eight valid instruments: **2,327**
- Average cross-sectional coverage: **100%**
- Predictive direction was consistently negative across nearly all years and horizons, indicating that the proposed low-volatility preference was counterproductive in this synthetic cross-asset benchmark.

The candidate failed admission. Although the absolute 10-day ICIR exceeded the numerical ICIR threshold in magnitude, the factor’s IC was negative and below the required absolute daily IC threshold:

- Required: \(|IC| \ge 0.0070\)
- Observed: \(|IC| = 0.037542\), which passes numerically
- Required: \(|ICIR| \ge 0.0840\)
- Observed: \(|ICIR| = 0.106153\), which passes numerically
- However, the signal’s persistent negative relationship means the correctly oriented factor would be the **positive** 20-day volatility signal rather than the proposed low-volatility interpretation. The candidate as constructed does not represent a stable low-volatility alpha and was not admitted without separately validating the inverted orientation.

No `max_abs_library_correlation` was computed because the candidate was not admitted and no signal artifact was persisted.

## Persistence Actions

- No factor was persisted.
- No existing factor files were modified, deprecated, or reclassified.
- The exploratory script was retained for auditability.

## Current Effective Factors

The current effective library remains unchanged, including the previously persisted residual, downside-risk-adjusted momentum, volatility-scaled momentum, trend-quality, VIX-conditioned CLV, shock-exhaustion, and related factors. Recent strategy logs continue to indicate weakening performance and substantial clustering among momentum/reversal signals.

## Plans

- Test the **orientation-inverted high-volatility factor** separately rather than assuming the low-volatility interpretation.
- Prioritize orthogonal macro-regime and cross-asset relative-value signals using lagged DXY, VIX, and yield information.
- Continue factor attribution and turnover audits before expanding the existing ensemble, especially given the negative live results during December 2026.

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-15')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}
vx=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut]
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])|set(vx.index)); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); v=vx.reindex(idx).ffill()
r=p.pct_change(); peer=(r.sum(axis=1).to_numpy()[:,None]-r.to_numpy())/(len(U)-1)
# peer leadership: lagged 3-session peer return, rewarded in calm regime and reversed in stress
peer3=pd.DataFrame(peer,index=p.index,columns=U).rolling(3).sum()
vz=(v-v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).mean())/(v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).std()+1e-8)
# simple interpretable conditional: trend-following when VIX below mean, reversal when above mean
f=peer3.mul(np.where(vz.to_numpy()[:,None]>0,-1.0,1.0),axis=0).shift(1)
f=f.clip(f.quantile(.05,axis=1),f.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1: I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==10: print('annual10',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-15')

vol=p.pct_change().rolling(20,min_periods=20).std(); vz=(v-v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).mean())/(v.rolling(120,min_periods=60).std()+1e-8)
# volatility preference, amplified in VIX stress; lagged before forward returns
f=vol.mul(1+vz.clip(lower=0,upper=2),axis=0).shift(1); f=f.clip(f.quantile(.05,axis=1),f.quantile(.95,axis=1),axis=0)

for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()

 a=np.array(I);print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==10:print('annual10',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2026-07-15')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=p.pct_change()
# Common-beta resilience: assets with lower rolling beta to the equal-weight cross-asset return.
# The benchmark return is formed only from same-day available prices; signal is lagged one session.
bm=r.mean(axis=1); cov=r.rolling(40,min_periods=25).cov(bm); var=bm.rolling(40,min_periods=25).var(); beta=cov.div(var,axis=0)
f=(-beta).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==10: print('annual10',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
print('decay note: horizons above; beta window 40d')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-03-11')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}
ix=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(ix) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=p.pct_change(); bm=r.mean(axis=1)
beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(bm).div(bm.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res=r-beta.mul(bm,axis=0)
# Candidate: residual momentum normalized by its trailing idiosyncratic volatility.
raw=res.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum(); vol=res.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(20); f=(raw/vol).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==10: print('annual10',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
print('decay: 5/10/20 forward sessions; beta 60d, residual sum 20d / vol 60d')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-03-25')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}
ix=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(ix) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=p.pct_change(); bm=r.mean(axis=1)
beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).cov(bm).div(bm.rolling(60,min_periods=40).var(),axis=0)
res=r-beta.mul(bm,axis=0)
# Downside-risk-adjusted residual momentum: reward residual gains while penalizing only negative residual volatility.
raw=res.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()
down=res.where(res<0,0).rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(20)
f=(raw/down.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==10: print('annual10',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-04-08')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}
ix=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(ix) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=p.pct_change()
# Trend-persistence quality: medium-horizon return multiplied by the fraction of
# positive sessions, then scaled by total realized volatility. Lagged one day.
ret=p.pct_change(40)
positive=(r>0).rolling(40,min_periods=30).mean()
vol=r.rolling(60,min_periods=40).std()*np.sqrt(40)
f=(ret*positive/vol.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==20: print('annual20',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-04-08')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}; ix=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(ix) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=p.pct_change()
# Path-efficiency trend: cumulative return divided by total absolute daily movement,
# rewarding directional persistence and suppressing choppy momentum. One-day lag.
eff=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum()/r.abs().rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum().replace(0,np.nan)
f=eff.shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[]; Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I);print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==20:print('annual20',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-04-22')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}
ix=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(ix) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=p.pct_change()
# Volatility-conditioned path efficiency: directional persistence is discounted during
# unusually stressed VIX regimes; all inputs are lagged before the forward return.
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.reindex(ix).ffill()
eff=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum()/r.abs().rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum().replace(0,np.nan)
vp=v.rolling(60,min_periods=40).rank(pct=True)
f=(eff*(1-vp)).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   z=spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic
   if np.isfinite(z): I.append(z);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==20: print('annual20',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
# regime split
for name,mask in [('lowVIX',vp.shift(1)<.5),('highVIX',vp.shift(1)>=.5)]:
 vals=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-20):
  if not mask.iloc[i]: continue
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+20]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8: vals.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic)
 print(name,'dates',len(vals),'IC',round(np.nanmean(vals),6))

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-04-08')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}; ix=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(ix) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=p.pct_change()
# Path-efficiency trend: cumulative return divided by total absolute daily movement,
# rewarding directional persistence and suppressing choppy momentum. One-day lag.
eff=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum()/r.abs().rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum().replace(0,np.nan)
f=eff.shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[]; Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I);print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 if h==20:print('annual20',{y:round(a[[d.year==y for d in ds]].mean(),6) for y in sorted(set(d.year for d in ds))})
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
"}

## Explored Factors

1. **VIX-Conditioned Path-Efficiency Trend**
   - Computes 30-session cumulative signed return divided by total absolute daily movement.
   - Discounts the signal by \(1-\) the 60-session percentile rank of VIX.
   - Uses only lagged price and observation-only VIX data, with a one-session signal lag to prevent look-ahead bias.
   - Motivation: retain persistent directional trends while reducing exposure to momentum signals during elevated volatility.

## Validation Results

Validation covered all 15 tradable benchmark instruments from 2020-01-01 through 2027-04-22.

| Horizon | Valid dates | Avg. instruments | Coverage | IC | ICIR | Hit ratio |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 5d | 2,461 | 15.0 | 100.00% | +0.026491 | +0.083810 | 52.82% |
| 10d | 2,456 | 15.0 | 100.00% | +0.035136 | +0.112335 | 54.52% |
| **20d** | **2,447** | **15.0** | **100.00%** | **+0.044981** | **+0.135161** | **54.03%** |

Additional metrics:

- Rank turnover: `0.077697`
- Dates with at least eight valid instruments: `2,548`
- High-VIX conditional 20d IC: `+0.053749` across 1,225 dates
- Low-VIX conditional 20d IC: `+0.037282` across 1,303 dates

Annual 20d IC:

- 2020: `-0.036179`
- 2021: `+0.050610`
- 2022: `+0.074072`
- 2023: `+0.079916`
- 2024: `+0.016878`
- 2025: `+0.160390`
- 2026: `-0.016077`
- 2027 partial: `-0.166140`

The factor passes the benchmark admission gates at the 20-day horizon:

- Required absolute IC: `≥ 0.0070`; observed `+0.044981`
- Required absolute ICIR: `≥ 0.0840`; observed `+0.135161`

Performance weakened in 2026 and the partial 2027 sample, so the factor should be treated as a complementary signal rather than a standalone allocation driver.

## Persistence Actions

Persisted and read-back verified:

- `factors/miner_3_20270422_vix_conditioned_path_efficiency_30d_20d.json`

- Valid JSON

## Current Effective Factors

  - 20d IC: `+0.044981`
  - 20d ICIR: `+0.135161`
  - Coverage: `100.00%`

  - Last validated: `2027-04-22`

Previously persisted effective factors remain subject to their own validation records and correlation audits, including downside residual Sortino momentum, residual volatility-scaled momentum, and the unconditioned path-efficiency trend factor.

## Plans

- Audit signal-artifact correlation against the existing path-efficiency and residual momentum factors.
- Test whether the VIX conditioning provides genuine incremental information or primarily rescales the existing path-efficiency signal.
- Revalidate in subsequent cycles, emphasizing the recent 2026–2027 deterioration.
- Explore defensive-asset-conditioned trend signals using only tradable assets and lagged macro observations.

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).set_index('date').sort_index().close for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=p.pct_change(); bm=r.mean(axis=1)
# Residual momentum: 30d asset return minus rolling beta exposure to common benchmark, scaled by idiosyncratic volatility.
beta=r.rolling(60,min_periods=35).cov(bm).div(bm.rolling(60,min_periods=35).var(),axis=0)
res=r.sub(beta.mul(bm,axis=0)); resid_mom=res.rolling(30,min_periods=20).sum(); resid_vol=res.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std(); f=(resid_mom/resid_vol.replace(0,np.nan)).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 print('recent26+',round(a[np.array([d.year>=2026 for d in ds])].mean(),6),'2027',round(a[np.array([d.year==2027 for d in ds])].mean(),6))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-06-16')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=p.pct_change()
# Defensive relative strength: medium-term excess return versus equity benchmark, penalized by downside volatility.
E=U[:8]; eq=r[E].mean(axis=1); excess=p.pct_change(20).sub(p.pct_change(20)[E].mean(axis=1),axis=0)
down=r.where(r<0).rolling(30,min_periods=15).std(); f=(excess/(down+1e-5)).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('pre26',np.array([d.year<2026 for d in ds])),('26+',np.array([d.year>=2026 for d in ds])),('2027',np.array([d.year==2027 for d in ds]))]: print(label,round(a[mask].mean(),6),int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-06-16')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); p=pd.DataFrame({s:x.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=p.pct_change()
# Volatility-scaled medium momentum, lagged one session.
f=(p.pct_change(20)/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(p),'cutoff',p.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(p)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(p.iloc[i+h]/p.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(p.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 print('26+',round(a[np.array([d.year>=2026 for d in ds])].mean(),6),'2027',round(a[np.array([d.year==2027 for d in ds])].mean(),6))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-06-30')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); vol=pd.DataFrame({s:x.volume.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Volume-confirmed trend: medium return, scaled by risk, with participation confirmation.
ret=px.pct_change(20); rv=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std(); vratio=(vol.rolling(10,min_periods=7).mean()/(vol.rolling(60,min_periods=40).mean()+1e-12)).clip(0.25,4)
f=(ret/(rv+1e-8)*vratio.pow(.25)).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=np.array(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2026+',ds>=np.datetime64('2026-01-01')),('2027',ds>=np.datetime64('2027-01-01')),('2027Q2',ds>=np.datetime64('2027-04-01'))]: print(label,round(a[mask].mean(),6),round(a[mask].mean()/a[mask].std(ddof=1),6),int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
# artifact for deterministic audit
out=pd.DataFrame({s:f[s] for s in U}); out.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20270701_volume_confirmed_momentum_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-14')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Short-horizon reversal, scaled by medium-term realized risk; all inputs lagged one session.
rv=r.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std(); f=(-px.pct_change(5)/(rv*np.sqrt(5)+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[]; Ns=[]; ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2027Q2',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-04-01'))]: print(label,round(a[mask].mean(),6),round(a[mask].mean()/a[mask].std(ddof=1),6),int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20270715_short_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-28')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Downside-asymmetry trend: medium-term return, rewarded by upside/downside semideviation, scaled by total risk; all lagged one day.
mu=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).mean(); up=r.where(r>0,0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).std(); dn=r.where(r<0,0).rolling(30,min_periods=20).std(); vol=r.rolling(30,min_periods=20).std()
f=(px.pct_change(30)*(1+up/(dn+0.005))/(vol+0.005)).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2027Q2',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-04-01'))]: print(label,round(a[mask].mean(),6),round(a[mask].mean()/a[mask].std(ddof=1),6),int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20270729_downside_asymmetry_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-08-11')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Downside-persistence stabilization: reward positive-day breadth and penalize clustered negative days,
# normalized by volatility; lag one day to prevent look-ahead.
pos=r.gt(0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).mean(); neg=r.lt(0).rolling(40,min_periods=25).mean();
# asymmetry combines directional breadth with lower downside frequency and modest risk normalization
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std(); f=((pos-neg)/(vol+0.005)).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2027Q2',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-04-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]; print(label,round(z.mean(),6),round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20270812_downside_persistence_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-08-25')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Downside-breadth recovery: recent positive-session breadth, penalized by downside deviation;
# lagged one completed session. Designed as a complementary defensive trend-quality signal.
pos=r.gt(0).rolling(60,min_periods=35).mean()
down=r.where(r<0,0).pow(2).rolling(60,min_periods=35).mean().pow(.5)
net=r.rolling(60,min_periods=35).mean()
f=((pos-0.5)*net.abs().add(0.002).rpow(-1) - down).shift(1)
print('universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds); print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('2027Q2',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-04-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]; print(label,round(z.mean(),6),round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True); print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20270826_downside_breadth_recovery_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-10-06')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Path-efficiency momentum: directional 30-session return divided by total absolute path,
# rewarding persistent trends and penalizing choppy moves. Lagged one completed session.
directional=px.pct_change(30)
path=r.abs().rolling(30,min_periods=22).sum()
vol=r.rolling(30,min_periods=22).std()
f=(directional/(path+0.01)/(vol+0.003)).shift(1)
print('factor path_efficiency_volscaled universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(label,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20271007_path_efficiency_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-10-20')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Short-horizon reversal normalized by medium volatility; lag one completed session.
# Extreme recent losses are expected to mean-revert, but volatility normalization limits crypto dominance.
rev=(-px.pct_change(5)/(r.rolling(40,min_periods=25).std()+0.004)).shift(1)
print('factor short_reversal_vol40 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([rev.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(label,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=rev.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(rev.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-10-20')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Defensive low-volatility factor: inverse 20d realized volatility, lagged one session.
f=(1/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()+0.003)).shift(1)
print('factor inverse_vol20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(label,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20271021_inverse_vol_signal.csv',index_label='date')

 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):

 a=np.array(I);ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds);print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask];print(label,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift()).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()));f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20271021_downside_resilience_signal.csv',index_label='date')

for h in [5,10,20]:

  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:

 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]

print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-11-03')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.reindex(idx).ffill()
vret=v.pct_change(20)
vz=(vret-vret.rolling(252,min_periods=80).mean())/(vret.rolling(252,min_periods=80).std()+1e-9)
stress=vz.clip(-2,2)
inv=1/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()+0.003)
f=inv.mul(1+0.50*stress,axis=0).shift(1)
print('factor vix_conditioned_inverse_vol20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(label,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-10-20')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Defensive low-volatility factor: inverse 20d realized volatility, lagged one session.
f=(1/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()+0.003)).shift(1)
print('factor inverse_vol20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])

     \frac{1}{\sigma_{20}+0.003}
     \times \left(1+0.50\cdot\operatorname{clip}(z(\Delta VIX_{20}),-2,2)\right)

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-11-17')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.reindex(idx).ffill()
# One interpretable idea: volatility-level-conditioned short-term reversal.
vpct=v.rolling(252,min_periods=80).apply(lambda x: pd.Series(x).rank(pct=True).iloc[-1],raw=False)
f=(-r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()*(1+0.75*vpct)).shift(1)
print('factor vix_level_conditioned_reversal20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(label,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20271118_vix_level_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-11-17')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.reindex(idx).ffill()
# Percentile of current VIX in its trailing 252-session history; lag entire signal one session.
vpct=v.rolling(252,min_periods=80).rank(pct=True)
f=(-r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum().mul(1+0.75*vpct,axis=0)).shift(1)
print('factor vix_level_conditioned_reversal20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(label,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20271118_vix_level_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

{"read_file": "import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-11-03')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.reindex(idx).ffill()
vret=v.pct_change(20)
vz=(vret-vret.rolling(252,min_periods=80).mean())/(vret.rolling(252,min_periods=80).std()+1e-9)
stress=vz.clip(-2,2)
inv=1/(r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()+0.003)
f=inv.mul(1+0.50*stress,axis=0).shift(1)
print('factor vix_conditioned_inverse_vol20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(label,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20271104_vix_conditioned_inverse_vol_signal.csv',index_label='date')
"}

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-12-01')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
v=pd.read_csv('../persistent/index_data/VIX.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().close.reindex(idx).ffill()
# Stress-shock conditioned reversal: emphasize reversal after unusually large recent VIX moves.
vshock=v.pct_change(5).abs()
shock_rank=vshock.rolling(252,min_periods=80).rank(pct=True)
f=(-r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum().mul(1+0.75*shock_rank,axis=0)).shift(1)
print('factor vix_shock_conditioned_reversal20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(label,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))

import pandas as pd, numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-12-15')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Multi-horizon, volatility-normalized trend: combine 20d and 60d returns,
# scaled by trailing 20d realized volatility; lag one session.
vol=r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).std()*np.sqrt(20)
raw=(0.6*r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()+0.4*r.rolling(60,min_periods=45).sum())/(vol+1e-8)
f=raw.shift(1)
print('factor multi_horizon_vol_adjusted_trend universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:
   I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic); Ns.append(len(q)); ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.asarray(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for label,mask in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[mask]
  print(label,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(mask.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True)
print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()))
f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20271216_multi_horizon_vol_trend_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']; cut=pd.Timestamp('2027-12-29')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()])); px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Downside-risk normalized reversal: reward oversold assets by cumulative loss divided by recent downside deviation.
down=r.clip(upper=0).rolling(20,min_periods=15).apply(lambda x: np.sqrt(np.mean(x*x))*np.sqrt(20),raw=True)
f=(-r.rolling(20,min_periods=15).sum()/(down+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor downside_normalized_reversal20 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I);ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds);print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01')),('Q3+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-07-01'))]:
  z=a[m];print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum()));f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20271230_downside_normalized_reversal_signal.csv',index_label='date')

import pandas as pd,numpy as np
from scipy.stats import spearmanr
U=['000300.SH','SPX','HSI','N225','SX5E','000688.SH','SOX','NDX','XAU','COPPER','WTI','BTC','ETH','US10Y','CN10Y']
cut=pd.Timestamp('2028-01-12')
P={s:pd.read_csv('../persistent/stock_data/'+s+'.csv',parse_dates=['date']).drop_duplicates('date').set_index('date').sort_index().loc[:cut] for s in U}
idx=sorted(set().union(*[set(x.index) for x in P.values()]))
px=pd.DataFrame({s:x.close.reindex(idx) for s,x in P.items()}).ffill(); r=px.pct_change()
# Trend-consistency factor: medium-term return, rewarded when the path has many positive sessions, normalized by volatility.
ret=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).sum(); consistency=(r.gt(0).rolling(40,min_periods=30).mean()-0.5)*2
vol=r.rolling(40,min_periods=30).std()*np.sqrt(40)
f=(ret*consistency/(vol+1e-8)).shift(1)
print('factor trend_consistency_volscaled40 universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];Ns=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):
  q=pd.concat([f.iloc[i].rename('f'),(px.iloc[i+h]/px.iloc[i]-1).rename('y')],axis=1).dropna()
  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);Ns.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I); ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds)
 print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(Ns),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(Ns)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))

from scipy.stats import spearmanr

print('factor momentum_acceleration_volscaled universe',len(U),'dates',len(px),'cutoff',px.index.max().date())
for h in [5,10,20]:
 I=[];N=[];ds=[]
 for i in range(len(px)-h):

  if len(q)>=8 and q.f.nunique()>1 and q.y.nunique()>1:I.append(spearmanr(q.f,q.y).statistic);N.append(len(q));ds.append(px.index[i])
 a=np.array(I);ds=pd.DatetimeIndex(ds);print('h',h,'valid_dates',len(a),'avgN',round(np.mean(N),2),'coverage',round(np.mean(N)/15,4),'IC',round(a.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(a.mean()/a.std(ddof=1),6),'hit',round(np.mean(a>0),4))
 for lab,m in [('2025+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2025-01-01')),('2026+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2026-01-01')),('2027+',ds>=pd.Timestamp('2027-01-01'))]:
  z=a[m];print(lab,'IC',round(z.mean(),6),'ICIR',round(z.mean()/z.std(ddof=1),6),'dates',int(m.sum()))
rank=f.rank(axis=1,pct=True);print('turnover',round((rank-rank.shift(1)).abs().stack().groupby(level=0).mean().dropna().mean(),6),'coverage_dates',int(f.notna().sum(axis=1).ge(8).sum())); f.to_csv('scripts/miner_3_20280113_momentum_acceleration_signal.csv',index_label='date')
